reviews.text: I don't like to do these things, but the service we received yesterday was terrible. Unfortunately, my dog ​​ended up with a lot of snips in her hair; a Pomeranian shouldn't be treated like that, and I would have preferred they had told me they didn't have experience with that breed and let me decide.

I went twice in the same week with my dog ​​looking for information, and they never opened the door. The first time, I called and called, and no one answered, even though there were dogs inside and the lights were on. I called the phone number several times, and they didn't answer. I came back another day, and the woman at the store reluctantly claimed she couldn't open the door because she didn't have her keys (hardly believable, since Proud was inside with two dogs). Then she said I would have to wait for her colleague. Her attitude and lack of professionalism definitely confirmed that I don't want to leave my dog ​​at this daycare.

I took my dog ​​there and they did a fantastic job. I can only suggest they trim his nails a little shorter. Otherwise, the staff were friendly and very professional. I highly recommend them and will be back soon.

My experience with this hair salon has been very disappointing. Last-minute cancellations. Unfortunately, it's not the first time they've canceled an appointment with very little notice; in fact, this is the third or fourth time it's happened.

I completely understand that a medical emergency can arise, and I sincerely hope the hairdresser is alright. What I find unprofessional is that this type of situation has been repeated several times. When you book an appointment, you plan your time and expect the service to be provided, especially when you have an upcoming trip.

On this last occasion, they also notified me practically at the last minute, leaving me no time to find another alternative and with a problem I hadn't anticipated.

An isolated incident can be understandable, but when cancellations become a recurring issue, it ends up generating frustration and makes you completely lose confidence in the establishment.

It's a shame, because precisely because I had booked with them before, I expected to receive reliable service. After this experience, I won't be returning.

Terrible. They're scammers. They charge extra if the dog has knots (which is normal in many groomers). The problem here is that our 3kg dog, whose hair was already cut because we had it trimmed a month ago due to the heat, was charged extra, claiming she had knots all over her body. Besides being scammers, they're liars. On top of that, our dog came back extremely depressed, something that has never happened to us at other groomers. I don't know what they did to her. Obviously, we won't be taking our dog there again. I'm sharing this so that no one else goes through the same thing. Seeing the comments, we were lucky they didn't hurt her.

I don't usually leave reviews, but after what happened to us, we couldn't wait.

This groomer was reasonably priced, and the groomer was very nice and always gave my dog ​​a great haircut. Then, on Friday, June 26, 2026, like any other day, I dropped my dog ​​off at the groomer, but I noticed the groomer had changed.

When I went to pick up my dog, he had several wounds. First, on his belly, and second, the inside of his ear was swollen. At first, I wasn't too worried, but when I got home, he wouldn't even let us touch his ear. He wouldn't let us pet him either and kept hiding. I got very worried, and the next day, I saw that his ear was much more swollen.

I took him to the emergency vet, and he told us he had wounds on the outside of both ears, as well as severe inflammation inside his ear. He even had a little pus coming out, and they explained that he'd also suffered an allergic reaction. They prescribed medication to relieve the pain.

Furthermore, they told us that our dog's ear hair was very matted and that the knots needed to be removed, so they charged us an extra fee, which we paid without complaint. Even after paying this additional amount, our dog ended up with wounds, and we had to cover another €180 in veterinary expenses. It's a completely unacceptable situation.

Also, I didn't want to say this, but they've ruined the trip we had already planned. We had already bought the plane tickets, and because of our dog's condition, we haven't been able to travel.

Highly recommended for taking your dog for a bath and haircut with complete confidence. They are all very friendly, especially Laura, who is very affectionate with our dog and gives a fantastic haircut.
The place is clean and very reasonably priced. Thank you for treating our beloved pets so well. ❤️
